meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Egypt (unitary national jurisdiction; GAFI One-Stop Shop governs incorporation with no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic-inspired codified system; Sharia is a source of legislation per Article 2 of the 2014 Constitution; commercial matters governed by Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 and Investment Law No. 72 of 2017)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Egypt-China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 1994, entered into force 1996)
Egypt-China Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (1999, as amended by 2016 Protocol)
Egypt-United States Treaty Concerning the Reciprocal Encouragement and Protection of Investments (in force 1992)
Egypt-United Kingdom BIT and UK-Egypt Development Cooperation
Arab League Investment Agreement and Greater Arab Free Trade Area (GAFTA) membership
COMESA (Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa) membership protections

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering (as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014 and Law No. 8 of 2015 on Terrorist Financing); Executive Regulations issued under the AML Law; binding instructions of the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU); Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) Board Decisions on beneficial ownership identification; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 and Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 requiring disclosure of shareholders, managers, and ultimate beneficial owners to GAFI.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Egypt is not a contracting state to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; chain: notarization in origin country -> Ministry of Foreign Affairs of origin country -> legalization by the Egyptian Consulate/Embassy in the origin country -> optional re-authentication by the Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Active Status Certificate for the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or competent corporate registrar in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization via the same notary-origin MFA-Egyptian Consulate chain

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport pages of each ultimate beneficial owner, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority of the beneficial owner's country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization via the same notary-origin MFA-Egyptian Consulate chain

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization via the same notary-origin MFA-Egyptian Consulate chain

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every UBO, director, manager, and material counterparty against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Egypt's national terrorism list maintained under Law No. 8 of 2015, Interpol notices, and domestic CFT watchlists; risk-based Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) under Law No. 80 of 2002; documented negative-media review; on-going transaction monitoring once banking relations are established.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI Electronic One-Stop Shop Portal (Invest in Egypt online platform, http://www.investinegypt.gov.eg) integrated with the Commercial Registry network administered by the Ministry of Trade and Industry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official company name must be in the Arabic language; a foreign-language version is permitted only as a transliteration or translation that exactly corresponds to the Arabic name, and the Arabic version prevails for all legal and registry purposes.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank and financial services terms (prior Central Bank of Egypt approval required)
Insurance and securities terms (prior Financial Regulatory Authority approval required)
Military and armed forces related terms
Islamic and Arab denominational terms (special ministerial clearance required)
Import and Export activity terms (subject to trade registry conditions)
Medical, Pharmaceutical, and Medical Devices terms (prior Egyptian Drug Authority approval required)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative reconsideration with the GAFI Companies Names Committee within 15 working days of the rejection notice, simultaneously reserving an alternative secondary name; if the administrative reconsideration is denied, the applicant may initiate annulment proceedings before the competent Administrative Court within 60 days of the denial. Where rejection is based on a licensed activity term, the applicant must first obtain the sponsoring authority's approval (e.g., Egyptian Drug Authority for medical device manufacturing) before resubmitting the name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for the underlying industrial license: manufacture of sterile examination nitrile gloves requires a fixed industrial facility with valid title or registered lease acceptable to GAFI, the Industrial Development Authority, and the Egyptian Drug Authority. A virtual or service-only address cannot satisfy factory licensing, GMP, or Ministry of Health inspection requirements for medical PPE manufacturing.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 95% pre-incorporation/pre-license physical inspection of the registered industrial premises; 60-70% probability of unannounced annual compliance inspections by the Egyptian Drug Authority, Industrial Development Authority, and the Ministry of Health following start-up.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory service tariff for name reservation; prevailing market benchmark ranges from USD 10 to USD 20.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of Arabic Articles of Association, lease authorization, and UBO declarations before the Egyptian Notary Public

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 fee schedule and GAFI published tariff based on authorized capital band.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law No. 159 of 1981 with respect to Joint Stock Companies, Partnerships Limited by Shares, and Limited Liability Companies (LLC provisions: Articles 102–120); Commercial Registration Law No. 34 of 1976; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; Executive Regulations of Investment Law No. 2310 of 2018; Civil Code of Egypt (Book I, Obligations and Contracts).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Companies Registration and One-Stop-Shop Department, in coordination with the Commercial Registry of the Ministry of Trade and Industry.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Association (Memorandum of Association) of the Limited Liability Company, notarized before the Egyptian Notary Public and filed through the GAFI online investor portal (including the incorporation application, founder trust declarations, and specimen signature cards).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an LLC under Law No. 159/1981; the founding shareholders are free to determine the capital in the Articles of Association, provided that the capital is fully subscribed and each share has a par value of not less than EGP 100. The entire capital must be paid in cash or in kind at incorporation; no escrow account is required for non-incentive listings, but full proof of deposit into a corporate bank account opened in the entity's name is required at filing.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The founding shareholders adopt the Articles of Association of [Company Name] LLC and irrevocably subscribe to the entire issued capital of USD [Amount] divided into [Number] equal shares, certifying that all subscription contributions have been fully paid into the LLC's designated bank account; (2) The registered head office is established at [Full Address], Cairo, Arab Republic of Egypt, effective immediately; (3) [Name] and [Name] are appointed Co-Managing Directors with joint signature authority over banking, statutory filings, and daily operations; (4) The Managing Directors are authorized to execute all commercial registry, tax, social insurance, environmental, civil defense, and industrial licensing formalities necessary to commence lawful operation. All resolutions are effective upon issuance of the incorporation certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Legal Entity Style Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop-Shop / GAFI Electronic Investor Portal (www.efi.gov.eg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Login to the GAFI e-portal and submit 3 ranked proposed distinctive trade names (English and Arabic), each ending with 'LLC' and avoiding any contravention of Egyptian naming restrictions, Islamic public order, or trademarks registered in Egypt. Attach the scanned passport/commercial record of each founding shareholder and the draft commercial registry name availability check. Upon preliminary clearance, the name is reserved for 60 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Name availability search and reservation application form (GAFI digital)
Founders' passport copy or national ID for Egyptian individuals / certified board resolution of corporate founder
Consent letter for the proposed trade style signed by all founders
Power of attorney of the authorized incorporator (Arabic notarized, legalized if foreign)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or suspended, file a formal objection with the GAFI Registration Committee within 15 days, with evidence of distinctive character, or resubmit alternative names. A re-filing fee waiver applies for objections sustained within 10 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Articles of Association and Subscription Statements
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Notary Public (Dar Al-Tawthiq) Alternatively GAFI On-Site Notarization Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founders or their attorney must appear in person before the Notary Public to execute the Arabic-language Articles of Association. The instrument must state the LLC name, purpose, head office, capital, share split, management and representation rules, auditors, financial year, and an express clause that the object will engage in the manufacture of sterile examination nitrile gloves. If telephonic or electronic notarization is used, an e-signature must be docketed by the GAFI platform. The notarized minutes are assigned an official document registration number.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association (Arabic) in triplicate
Original GAFI name reservation certificate
Founders' valid national identification documents
Bank certificate evidencing full payment of the subscribed capital into the LLC's pre-incorporation account
Legalization documents for foreign founders (apostille where applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises formal defects (e.g., signature mismatches or missing annexures), the founding attorney may correct and re-file within 10 business days under a supplementary notarial addendum without a new incorporation filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Application Submission and GAFI Issuance of the Incorporation Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Companies Registration Department – One Stop Shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the consolidated e-dossier via the GAFI portal, attaching the notarized Articles of Association, capital certificate, and specimens of the managers' signatures. GAFI performs a legality review of the purpose clauses (including the medical device manufacturing scope), verifies the subscribed capital certificate, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation (Shahadat Al-Qayd) together with the Commercial Registration extract. The entity obtains its legal personality upon issuance of this certificate.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association (notarized copy elevated to GAFI)
Official incorporation application form signed by all founding partners
Statutory declaration of share subscription
Bank capital deposit certificate of the paid-up contributions
Founders' ID copies and specimen signatures of appointed managers
Attested lease contract or title deed of the registered head office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues a query on the corporate purpose or capital evidence, submit a supplementary memorandum and supporting document directly to the GAFI case officer within 10 working days; an oral efficacy hearing may be requested for complex manufacturing objectives. Correction of defects does not reset the legal personality date unless the Articles require re-notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Entry and Tax Registration (Tax Card and Value-Added Tax Certificate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Office of the Ministry of Trade and Industry; Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – Taxable Persons Registration Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After GAFI issuance, complete the commercial registration to obtain the trade registry number. Then, appear at the ETA branch of the registered office to obtain the unified Tax Card (Bitaqah Dharibiyyah), which covers income tax and withholding registration. Apply simultaneously for the VAT certificate on Form 51 since medical consumables sale will be subject to standard-rated VAT. Open a declared corporate bank account and update ETA with bank details within 30 days.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation and commercial registration extract
Articles of Association copy
Head office leasing contract authenticated by the Real Estate Registration office
Founders' and managers' national IDs/passports
Tax Registration Form 49 (TAX identification) and VAT Form 51
Proof of bank account opening or bank certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If ETA suspends the tax card for missing utility bills or lease registration, cure by submitting the title deed plus two recent electricity and water utility invoices of the registered office; the ETA must issue the card within 5 working days after compliance. Grievances are addressed to the ETA Appeals Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Insurance Registration and Employment Record Establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) – Local Insurance Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Social Insurance Form No. 1 (establishment registration) and Form No. 2 (employees' list) to the NOSI office for the company's address within 30 days of commercial registry issuance. Register managing directors separately under the LLC's contribution schedule. The social insurance certificate will be required for later operational permits and bank LC lines.
required_dossiers: Incorporation certificate and commercial registry extract
Tax card certificate
Form No. 1 (establishment registration) and Form No. 2 (insured persons)
List of employees with ID copies and employment contracts
Head office lease contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If NOSI rejects an employee record due to duplicate insurance numbers or mismatched civil data, certify corrected data through the Government Services Office and refile with the NOSI receipt envelope; a late registration penalty may be appealed with supporting official bank transfer proof.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) – Licensing Department under the Ministry of Trade and Industry (Law No. 15 of 2017 on Industrial Licensing), in coordination with the Ministry of Health and Population for medical device conformity of sterile gloves.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operating License (Idn Tashgheel) – Compulsory for the manufacture of sterile examination nitrile gloves (ISIC 3250 / Class B facility), including the production license approval and facility occupation license (Tashgheel).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) – Central Administration for Environmental Impact Assessment (Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009, Annex II List 'B' projects).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B – Limited EIA (Screening Form B) requiring a concise environmental impact assessment study due to industrial dipping, latex compounding, chemical curing, and wastewater discharge from glove production lines; no full public hearing EIA (Category C) required unless the facility is located in or within 2 km of a sensitive ecological zone.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must comply with Law 48/1982 and Ministerial Decree 92/2013 (listed maximum limits for pH 6–9, COD ≤ 600 mg/L, BOD ≤ 300 mg/L, TSS ≤ 400 mg/L, total phenols ≤ 0.05 mg/L, cyanide ≤ 0.1 mg/L, heavy metals – Zn ≤ 5 mg/L, Cu ≤ 1.5 mg/L). Air emissions for VOCs from drying/curing ovens must meet Ministerial Decree 338/1995: total volatile organic compounds (VOCs) ≤ 20 mg/m3 at stack discharge. Solid nitrile glove rejects and off-spec batches must be managed as hazardous industrial waste under Law 174/2020 with manifest tracking; liquid effluents require pre-treatment by neutralization and coagulation prior to any discharge into public sewer, with calibrated continuous pH flow meters installed at the factory gate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Directorates (Ministry of Interior): mandatory fire safety certification of the production hall, storage of isoprene and nitrile latex raw materials in segregated vaults per NFPA 30, automatic sprinkler and passive fire-stopping inspection reports, and a valid fire evacuation plan. Additionally, the Ministry of Manpower Occupational Safety and Health Department issues a workplace clearance certificate verifying compliance with Law 12/2003 and its executive decree – covering dip tank ventilation, compressed air safety, chemical glove-curing fume extraction, noise exposure limits (≤ 85 dB(A) per 8-hour shift), and the appointment of a certified industrial safety officer before manufacturing operations commence.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – Ministry of Finance; official e-portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; e-invoicing portal: https://invoicing.eta.gov.eg.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign investor establishing an EG LLC must first obtain commercial registration from the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) and then file an application for a Tax Card (Bayan) at the competent ETA tax office. The application requires the notarized ETA form, company contract, power of attorney, lease, board resolution, passport copies, and appointment of an Egyptian tax agent. The ETA issues a corporate Tax Identification Number (TIN) and, for taxable activities, a VAT certificate; VAT registration is mandatory once annual taxable supplies exceed EGP 500,000 or when the non-resident makes chargeable supplies in Egypt. Processing typically takes 15–30 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or elective pass-through regime exists for Egyptian LLCs; an LLC is irrevocably taxed at the corporate level under Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005. An eligible company may apply for investment-free-zone or special-zone incentives under Free Zones Law No. 83 of 2002 / Law No. 194 of 2008, but this is not a tax classification election. Egypt has not implemented a US-style S-election, and no hybrid mismatch elections are separately available for a standard LLC.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016, effective 1 September 2016.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 of annual taxable supply value. Exporters and non-resident suppliers with a place of supply in Egypt are required or entitled to register irrespective of this threshold when they make taxable supplies in Egypt or need to exercise refund rights.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Registered taxpayers must issue all B2B and B2G invoices, and, depending on turnover phase, e-receipts through the ETA e-invoicing system. Invoices are structured as XML/JSON and transmitted via ETA-certified APIs. The ETA performs real-time schema validation, assigns a Unique Identifier (UUID), embeds a QR code, and returns a digital acceptance stamp serving as fiscal clearance; a UUID-less invoice is not valid for input VAT deduction. Post-issuance matching creates automated audit flags for mismatched documentation, and non-compliance can lead to suspension of bank clearing and disallowance of input VAT.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for tangible merchandise physically exported outside Egypt under the customs regime when the exporter retains a certified export declaration and the sale is contracted to a non-resident customer at commercial terms that transfer ownership and risk abroad. Sterile examination nitrile gloves leaving Egyptian customs territory qualify for a 0% VAT rate provided payment is received from abroad and the goods are not re-imported. Services directly connected to exported goods and consumed wholly outside Egypt are also zero-rated. The ETA may require proof of outward movement within 180 days from shipment and a valid bank inward remittance certificate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (Bayan) signed and stamped by Egyptian Customs and approved by the Egyptian Tax Authority
Original Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure of the consignment from Egypt
Signed commercial invoice and purchase order or contract with the foreign customer
Bank inward remittance certificate, Swift TT advice, or LC settlement confirmation evidencing receipt of the hard-currency consideration in Egypt
Copy of the VAT return form declaring the zero-rated export supply
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Any false or materially inconsistent zero-rating file triggers retrospective assessment of unreported 14% VAT, delay tax, and a penalty of up to 100% of the tax due under Law 67/2016, plus fines under Customs Law No. 20 of 2020 for falsified declarations, including imprisonment up to five years for fraud. The ETA may also claw back refunds with a 14% reinstatement and require proof of transfer of export proceeds to Egypt within the 180-day foreign-exchange window; failure to do so subjects the exporter to Central Bank of Egypt sanctions, exchange-law penalties, potential deregistration from export privileges, and bank credit denials.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) — the sole monetary authority, bank licensor, and regulator of the Egyptian foreign-exchange market under Banking Law No. 194 of 2020 and CBE FX implementing rules; the CBE operates the interbank FX settlement platform and the purpose-of-transfer declaration system in coordination with the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) authority, and the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) for withholding-tax clearances on outgoing dividends and interest.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt has operated a liberalised exchange-rate regime since March 2024: the managed EGP peg was abolished and licensed banks price EGP/USD through a rules-based interbank platform. Current-account convertibility (export/import payments, service fees, dividends and interest remittances) is unrestricted for CBE-licensed banks against documentary justification; capital-account inward FDI requires no pre-approval but must be routed through an onshore bank and recorded in the CBE inward-investment repository to preserve free-transfer rights under Article 11 of the Investment Law No. 72 of 2017. Profit remittance hurdles are limited to the statutory dividend withholding tax under Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005 (as amended, or a lower rate under the applicable double-tax convention), presentation of audited financial statements, a valid tax card, and post-credit confirmation that the underlying surplus originates from repatriated export proceeds; USD-liquidity delays can arise in stressed periods, so treasury policy should prioritise medical-PPE collections and committed bank lines.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: 100% of goods-export proceeds must be repatriated to an onshore Egyptian bank within 9 months from the date of shipment for manufactured/packaged products (shorter 4-5 month deadlines apply to specified perishable categories); repatriation is evidenced by the customs export file and the bank's export-proceeds collection statement. There is NO mandatory conversion ratio into EGP: the exporter may retain proceeds in a USD foreign-currency account, convert them on the interbank platform at floating rates, or earmark them for import inputs. Non-repatriation within the deadline triggers forced EGP conversion at the prevailing rate, exclusion from Export Development Fund subsidy programmes, and customs/tax penalties.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational EGP current account + USD subsidiary account + capital-injection escrow sub-ledger
Operational EGP/USD twin accounts with export-proceeds repatriation sub-account
Operational EGP account + USD account with trade (LC) sub-limits
Corporate operational accounts (EGP + USD) with GAFI investment-file escrow account
Multi-currency corporate account (EGP/USD/EUR) with SWIFT direct clearing

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as a primary treasury rail. Egypt does not license offshore digital EMI/e-money institutions as settlement banks; under Retail Payment Services Law No. 18 of 2019, only CBE-licensed payment companies can operate e-wallets or merchant-acceptance rails. Onshore fintechs (Paymob, Fawry, MNT Group, Sympl) may support domestic collections, payroll, and merchant acceptance, but cross-border USD settlements must clear through a CBE-licensed bank's SWIFT membership. The nitrile-glove LLC must therefore adopt a bank-centric treasury with fintech periphery and must not rely on UK/EU EMIs for supplier settling, FX conversion, or dividend flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory in substance for a non-resident-owned EG LLC: at least one director/authorised signatory and the ultimate beneficial owner (or a notarised local attorney with power of attorney) must attend a face-to-face KYC interview at the corporate-banking branch, presenting original notarised commercial-register extract, GAFI investment certificate, tax card, Articles of Association, industrial licence, and passport copies. Documents executed abroad must be apostilled and, where required, legalised by the Egyptian consular post. Video-conferencing and e-KYC tools are permitted only as a pre-screen and cannot replace the branch interview, UBO identification, and biometric/signature verification mandated under CBE AML standards (Law No. 80 of 2002 and its executive regulations, as amended).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity created by a multi-tier foreign shareholding chain (offshore holding companies or regional family holding) that obscures the natural-person beneficiary of the EG LLC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Layered UBO disclosure chart, notarised shareholding certificates and constitutional documents for each offshore tier, apostilled commercial-register extracts of intermediate holding companies, passport copies and address verification of natural-person UBOs, group audited financial statements for the latest two years, a written source-of-wealth and source-of-funds memorandum, and evidence that no single transfer exceeds 25% of registered capital unless fully documented.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistency between the declared corporate purpose (ISIC-3250 medical-PPE manufacturing), the customs HS codes on imports/exports, and the reason-for-payment declared on treasury transfers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GAFI investment certificate referencing the exact industrial activity, industrial-register licence issued by the Egyptian Drug Authority (medical-device establishment licence for sterile examination gloves), a board resolution mapping every treasury outflow to the approved business plan, the CBE purpose-of-transfer declaration for each settlement, and consistent HS tariff classification (Chapter 4015 for vulcanised-rubber examination gloves and 3926.20 for synthetic-polymer or PVC equivalents) across all documents.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements and Audit Report (GAFI deposit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Companies Records Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year-end (30 June for calendar-year filers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing subjects the LLC to daily fines and suspension of GAFI clearance services, tax card issuance, and registration of investment incentives; continued failure may trigger administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 4 months after close of tax period - 30 April for calendar-year filers; extension to 30 June available with prior justification for audited accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of 2% of tax due per month of delay plus monthly interest on unpaid tax; an additional fine up to EGP 20,000 may be imposed; criminal sanctions apply to willful non-submission.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Payroll Withholding Tax Reconciliation and Form 6
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - Payroll Tax District
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the last day of February following the calendar tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 2% per month on unpaid PAYE, interest on late payment, and potential restriction of corporate tax clearance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - AML Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March following fiscal year-end, and within 15 days of any shareholding change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to update UBO records may result in fines under the AML Law, blocking of GAFI services, and/or administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Egyptian LLCs, irrespective of size, must appoint one or more licensed auditors at the annual general meeting; the audited financial statements must be filed with GAFI and, for investment-law companies, approved before distribution of dividends.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), converging with IFRS; financial statements must be in EGP and presented in the statutory formats.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under AML Law No. 80/2002 and its regulations, the LLC must maintain a register of ultimate beneficial owners at its registered office. While there is no standalone annual UBO filing for ordinary LLCs, an annual confirmation is submitted through GAFI's electronic system whenever shareholding changes or when the annual tax/commercial card is renewed; ownership changes above 10% trigger a mandatory notice within 15 days.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Egypt Investment Law No. 72/2017 grants a 50% reduction of taxable income for up to 5-7 years for qualifying light-manufacturing projects in governorates/zones (including SCZONE); with supportive infrastructure.
